name: benchmark-verification-repair
goal: Loop discovery skips incomplete local loop folders instead of blocking template search and verification

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Template search failed when existing local loop folders lacked loop.json; this also broke two pre-existing regression-loop tests.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Unchanged test/loop-discovery.test.ts failed with ExpectedCliError: Loop does not exist before the source repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Loop discovery reads loop state directly so its existing missing-file branch can skip incomplete folders.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged loop-discovery regression and six existing regression-loop tests pass; no expectations weakened.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Final bun run check passed with one Vitest worker, lower scheduling priority and limited esbuild concurrency. CLI has no affected browser UI path.
